plan.notes: Official KU current catalog, BA in Psychology sample 4-Year Graduation Plan (College of Liberal Arts and Sciences). All 8 term grids transcribed; term totals 15/17/13/15/15/15/15/15 sum to the published Total Hours 120. The major requires five 300+ level PSYC courses plus a social-issues course and electives; 'Second Area of Study' slots recorded generically per catalog (individual mapping done with advisor). Course titles verified against the KU catalog course listings. Retrieved 2026-10-10.
